attempts.summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (4096-bit RSA key, self-signed X.509 cert with CA:TRUE, 10-year validity), installed it into the system trust store via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors and update-ca-trust extract, and verified it is trusted both by `trust list`/`openssl verify` and functionally via an end-to-end TLS handshake with a leaf certificate signed by the CA. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured baseline boot ID and trust state, restarted node1 with systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot ID changed, and re-verified the CA trust anchor and full TLS trust chain post-restart.
